regions.observation: Stable hierarchy, clear active navigation, and an intentional compact rail at mobile; the active route exposes its Portuguese label inside the rail cell and all links retain named DOM labels.
Patient, species/sex/breed, external ID, tutor, active state, birth date and snapshot are visible before operational panels.
Context and server-derived next actions are prominent; the complete action array is now rendered without a silent four-row cap.
At mobile, service/status are stacked and operational values wrap instead of truncating; links and sample/result cues remain grouped.
Audit trail is legible and the latest-20 preview is now explicitly labeled when the authorized event set is larger.

The current ready state renders at 1440, 834 and 375 CSS pixels with no horizontal overflow or console errors; current metrics report zero CLS, at least 24px control height, loaded fonts and audited contrast pairs.

findings.location: mobile workspace item heading and operational values
findings.expected: Patient-facing operational labels remain readable at 375px.
findings.observed: Service, status and owner values could be clipped by ellipsis.
findings.resolution: Stacked the status badge and enabled intentional wrapping for critical operational copy.

findings.expected: A count must disclose the visible scope of a bounded preview.
findings.observed: A five-action count and a full timeline count could be read beside a partial visual list without scope language.
findings.resolution: Render all server-provided next actions and label timeline preview as latest N of total.

findings.observed: Previous faint and sidebar secondary colors measured 4.25:1 and 4.48:1.
findings.resolution: Adjusted only the secondary tokens to #62717A and #8EAAA9; audited pairs now pass.

findings.expected: Visible normal-size accent/status text meets the 4.5:1 contrast threshold on its actual surface.
findings.observed: A fresh visual audit found eyebrow, neutral-status, routine-priority and urgent-warning pairs below 4.5:1.
findings.resolution: Replaced the failing teal, neutral and amber foregrounds with audited semantic colors; all listed pairs now pass the 4.5:1 check and the current captures were regenerated.

findings.expected: A fresh independent visual critic reviews the post-fix render and issues final visual approval.
findings.observed: The earlier independent review was CONDITIONAL while the state matrix was incomplete.
findings.resolution: Fresh sealed read-only critic Epicurus inspected the complete final 18-artifact state/viewport matrix and returned APPROVE for the local visual scope; manual, target/golden and human release gates remain explicitly separated in VIS-016.

findings.expected: An authorized operator can reach all request pages returned by the server.
findings.observed: The UI ignored nextCursor and silently capped the visible request page.
findings.resolution: Consume nextCursor with an explicit load-more control, preserve already loaded requests, and cover cursor forwarding in the component regression.

findings.location: initial workspace loading and shell realtime status
findings.expected: Loading preserves the workspace geometry without a content jump.
findings.observed: The workspace used generic loading bars and the in-flow connecting banner produced a 0.1303 CLS shift.
findings.resolution: Added a named structural workspace skeleton, moved the transient realtime banner out of document flow, and measured CLS 0 at desktop, tablet, mobile and reduced-motion captures.

findings.expected: Operator-facing timeline copy is localized and does not expose internal event/state codes.
findings.observed: ResultRead, ResultDraftRead, ResultHistoryRead and RELEASED could appear as technical labels.
findings.resolution: Added explicit Portuguese event/state labels and a safe generic fallback; component regression covers ResultRead and RELEASED.

findings.expected: Current screenshots and packet digests describe the current working tree.
findings.observed: The prior packet digest did not match the current source and its screenshots predated the final UI fixes.
findings.resolution: Regenerated all three current captures, recomputed SHA-256 digests and added current metrics evidence without rewriting historical packets.

findings.expected: Operator-facing context does not expose raw internal department identifiers.
findings.observed: An unknown department code could previously render verbatim.
findings.resolution: Unknown departments now render as Setor não informado and the component regression asserts the raw code is absent.

findings.expected: The workspace preserves critical context without horizontal or critical-region overflow under narrow reflow and long operational copy.
findings.observed: The 188px extreme proxy initially overflowed by intrinsic heading/card minimums; long-copy and large-number coverage was previously absent.
findings.resolution: Added ultra-narrow layout constraints and executed current 188px, 320px and 375px reflow plus route-intercepted long-copy/large-number captures; all passed.

findings.expected: A narrow-viewport operator can identify the active navigation destination without relying on an icon glyph alone.
findings.observed: The active compact rail exposed only an icon because its visible label inherited the rail's zero-size text rule.
findings.resolution: Placed the active Portuguese label inside the rail cell, retained absolute tooltip behavior only for hover/focus, and retained aria-label/title names for every navigation link; responsive ready-state spot-check passed 3/3.

findings.expected: The active compact-rail label remains inside its navigation cell and does not overlap page content.
findings.observed: The independent review observed the active label using an absolute tooltip position that could intrude into the page.
findings.resolution: Separated active-label layout from hover/focus tooltip layout and added a mobile bounding-box regression; focused responsive and production-like full-matrix runs passed without retry.

findings.expected: Loading, error, denied, empty, partial, stale and complete states are visually inspected at desktop, tablet and mobile.
findings.observed: The matrix previously had ready-state coverage but lacked current cross-viewport captures for the degraded and transient states.
findings.resolution: Added deterministic loading, error/denied, empty, partial, stale and ready captures at 1440, 834 and 375 CSS pixels; the same executable scenario asserts state copy, recovery, no horizontal overflow and no console errors. Fresh sealed critic Epicurus inspected all 18 final PNGs and returned APPROVE for this local visual scope.

findings.expected: A dense mobile timeline exposes a compact preview and an accessible expansion path without clipping.
findings.observed: The initial inspected mobile capture did not demonstrate more than eight events in the compact timeline.
findings.resolution: Added a deterministic 12-event mobile fixture to the responsive E2E scenario; the collapsed state asserts 8 visible events and an accessible 'Mostrar mais eventos' control, while the expanded state asserts all 12 events and 'Mostrar menos eventos'. Focused memory, full memory and production-like 51/51 runs passed, with collapsed/expanded PNGs retained.

findings.expected: Screen-reader/touch ergonomics, product golden comparison and target Web Vitals are reviewed by authorized humans.
findings.observed: Only automated local checks and synthetic local captures are available.
findings.resolution: Obtain manual accessibility, product-golden, target/production performance and clinical/human release acceptance; do not infer them from local Playwright evidence.
